abstract: BACKGROUND: The safety and efficacy of chemotherapy for patients undergoing concomitant hemodialysis have not been fully established and optimal doses of anti-cancer drugs and best timing of hemodialysis remains unclear. Although chemosensitive cancers, such as germ cell tumors, treated with chemotherapy should have sufficient dose intensity maintained to achieve the desired effect, many patients with cancer undergoing hemodialysis might be under-treated because the pharmacokinetics of anti-cancer drugs in such patients remains unknown. CASE PRESENTATION: We describe a 31-year-old Japanese man with a mediastinal yolk sac tumor treated with surgery followed by five cycles of chemotherapy containing cisplatin and etoposide while concomitantly undergoing hemodialysis. The doses of these agents used in the first cycle were 50% of the standard dose of cisplatin (10 mg/m(2)) and 60% of the standard dose of etoposide (60 mg/m(2)) on days 1 through to 5; the doses were subsequently escalated to 75% with both agents. Hemodialysis was started 1 hour after infusions of these agents. Severe hematological toxicities were observed despite successful treatment. During treatment with concurrent hemodialysis, pharmacokinetic analysis of cisplatin was performed and its relationship with adverse effects was assessed. Compared with patients with normal renal function, the maximum drug concentration was higher, and concentration increased in the interval between hemodialysis and the subsequent cisplatin infusion, resulting in a higher area under the curve despite a reduction in the dose to 75% of the standard regimen. CONCLUSIONS: Because of the altered pharmacokinetics pharmacodynamics status of patients with renal dysfunction undergoing hemodialysis, pharmacokinetics pharmacodynamics analysis is deemed to be helpful for effective and safe management of chemotherapy in patients undergoing hemodialysis.
abstract_ja: 背景:血液透析を併用している患者に対する化学療法の安全性と有効性は十分に確立されておらず、抗がん剤の至適用量および血液透析の至適実施時期も不明である。化学感受性の高い胚細胞腫瘍などのがんに対する化学療法では、所望の効果を得るために十分な用量強度を維持する必要があるが、血液透析を受けているがん患者の多くは、この種の患者における抗がん剤の薬物動態が不明であるため、治療量が不十分となる可能性がある。症例提示:31歳の日本人男性が、縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍に対して手術を施行され、その後、血液透析を併用しながらシスプラチンとエトポシドを含む化学療法を5サイクル受けた。第1サイクルで使用した薬剤の用量は、シスプラチンが標準用量(10 mg/m²)の50%、エトポシドが標準用量(60 mg/m²)の60%で、1~5日目に投与した。その後、両薬剤とも75%に増量した。血液透析は薬剤投与の1時間後に開始した。治療は成功したが、重篤な血液毒性が認められた。透析併用中にシスプラチンの薬物動態解析を行い、有害事象との関連を評価した。腎機能が正常な患者と比較して、最高薬物濃度が高く、血液透析後から次回のシスプラチン投与までの間に濃度が上昇し、標準レジメンの75%に減量したにもかかわらず、曲線下面積が高値となった。結論:血液透析を受けている腎機能障害患者では薬物動態および薬力学的状態が変化するため、薬物動態・薬力学解析は、血液透析患者における化学療法の有効かつ安全な管理に有用と考えられる。
